findings.passage: “A picture of someone’s photo doesn’t get compared with anything (at the election office.) It could be a picture of anyone,” Bloxom, of Mappsville, told Watchdog.org.
findings.note: Quoted by the Roanoke Star (from Watchdog.org) on a bill to require a photo copy with mail-in absentee ballot requests. Date taken from the article URL. In the same article he is quoted as saying “You need a way to double-check,” and the writer says he suggested sharing the DMV database.
subjects: ID with a mail or absentee ballot or request

findings.motion: Passage of HB 1318, absentee ballot applications must include a copy of photo ID (62-Y 34-N)
findings.note: HB 1318 required a copy of an accepted ID with a mail or fax absentee ballot application, with exemptions for military, overseas and disabled voters. He is on the nay list.
subjects: ID with a mail or absentee ballot or request

findings.note: A yea was a vote to override the veto; the override failed. He is on the nay list.
